#### Harmony Ignite™ Platform

## Turn Data into Impact.

**_Become a data contributor. Unlock new value from your data._**

Your organization’s data holds enormous potential. Participating in the Harmony Ignite™ Platform enables health systems to transform archived data from Harmony Healthcare IT’s HealthData Platform™ into longitudinal, research-ready datasets and healthcare datasets for AI — without operational lift.

[Contact Us](https://www.harmonyhit.com/harmony-ignite/#global-cta-form)

![](https://www.harmonyhit.com/wp-content/smush-webp/2026/05/HI-Logo-Stacked.png.webp)

## **Why Participate in the Harmony Ignite™ Platform**

The Harmony Ignite™ Platform curates data already managed by Harmony Healthcare IT into de-identified, longitudinal healthcare datasets that can be securely accessed by approved partners across technology, life sciences, and research organizations.

As part of this model, organizations participate in health system data partnerships that support innovation in the healthcare industry. Participation is fully managed by Harmony Healthcare IT, enabling you to contribute data and support innovation without burdening your teams.

## Zero Cost. Zero Lift. Shared Value.

Organizations across AI, life sciences, and research are seeking access to secure, high-quality, de-identified healthcare datasets for defined use cases. Your existing archives can be transformed into research-ready datasets and healthcare datasets for AI that support innovation and generate new value.

**De-identified healthcare data supports:**

- Responsible healthcare AI development
- Academic and population health research
- Real-world data and outcomes analysis
- Healthcare data for analytics and decision-making
- Studies powered by longitudinal patient data

## Compliant and Secure Data Contribution

Patient privacy and data governance are embedded throughout the Harmony Ignite™ platform. Access to data is strictly controlled and limited to authorized processes and personnel, with broader access to datasets permitted only after de-identification and certification. All access is governed through role-based permissions, data use agreements, and established security and compliance controls, ensuring data is protected and used only for approved purposes.

## **Unlock More Value from Your Data**

The Harmony Ignite™ Platform is purpose-built to help healthcare organizations extend the value of their existing archived data, without adding operational burden. By making de-identified patient data usable and actionable beyond its original purpose, participating enables you to fuel breakthroughs in research and care delivery, while benefiting from a new income stream.

## Let’s Talk About What Participating Looks Like for You.
